林柯看上去大大咧咧，意外地十分敏锐。

她看到靳兰玦一袭无袖长裙，精致小皮鞋和披散的长发，怎么都不像会只身一人出现在荒郊野岭的样子。

林柯问：“你还有同伴吗？”

靳兰玦在心中摸清了两人的底细，当即就决定实话实话：

“我是被三个人绑架的，当时我们正经过国道。”

林柯和徐阳面面相觑。

靳兰玦继续说：

“有一个叫老黄的司机，跟我出现在同一片树林，但是他应该被收取了呼吸的功能，当场就死了。

还有一个叫胡哥的光头，变成了瞎子……我不确定，但是看到一条蛇钻进他的脑子之后，我就吓跑了。”

“等等等，”徐阳叫停，“一条蛇，钻进来他的，脑子？”

靳兰玦点头，比划了一下：“这么长，这么粗。”

两人倒抽一口气。

“怎么可能？！”

林柯淡定一点，摸着下巴思索：“或许是幻象？”

靳兰玦软萌无害地擦眼角：“我也不知道，太吓人了……”

听到她哽咽的声音，林柯连忙拍拍她的后背：

“别怕别怕，接下来我们一起走啊！”

靳兰玦一脸茫然：

“我们要走去哪儿？

这个地方好奇怪，不管怎么走好像都在兜圈子，那个光头本来追着我，突然就消失了……”

林柯耐心回答：

“这里应该是一座迷宫，具体的没时间说，总之，我们认为，闭上眼睛，应该就可以走到山顶了。

我们觉得，山顶就是迷宫的出口。”

靳兰玦垂眼应声，这两人的推断与自己的猜测一致，跟着他们一起，成功离开的几率会大很多。

她十分乖巧地点头：

“我会乖乖听话的，你们不要丢下我，我好害怕……这里都是奇奇怪怪的东西……”

林柯一看她要哭不哭的模样，顿时心软，搂着她的肩膀安慰：

“放心啦，我们肯定不会丢下你的！”

Lin Ke looked carefree and surprisingly sharp.

She saw that Jin Lanjue was wearing a sleeveless long skirt, exquisite leather shoes and long hair. She didn't look like he would be alone in the wilderness.

Lin Ke asked: "Do you have any companions?"

Jin Lanjue figured out the details of the two of them in his heart, and immediately decided to tell the truth:

"I was kidnapped by three people while we were passing through the national highway."

Lin Ke and Xu Yang looked at each other.

Jin Lanjue continued:

"There was a driver named Lao Huang who appeared in the same woods as me, but he was probably disabled from breathing and died on the spot.

There was also a bald man named Brother Hu who became blind...I'm not sure, but after seeing a snake getting into his head, I was scared away."

"Wait a minute," Xu Yang stopped, "a snake got into his brain?"

Jin Lanjue nodded and gestured: "So long, so thick."

The two gasped.

"How is that possible?!"

Lin Ke calmed down a little, rubbed his chin and thought, "Maybe it's an illusion?"

Jin Lanjue wiped the corners of his eyes softly and harmlessly: "I don't know, it's too scary..."

Hearing her choked voice, Lin Ke quickly patted her back:

"Don't be afraid, don't be afraid, let's go together next!"

Jin Lanjue looked confused:

"Where are we going?

This place is so strange. No matter how I walk, I seem to be going in circles. The bald head was chasing me and then suddenly disappeared..."

Lin Ke answered patiently:

"This should be a maze. We don't have time to say the details. In short, we think that if we close our eyes, we should be able to reach the top of the mountain.

We feel that the top of the mountain is the exit of the maze."

Jin Lanjue lowered his eyes and responded. The two men's inferences were consistent with his own guesses. If he followed them, his chances of successfully leaving would be much greater.

She nodded very obediently:

"I will be obedient, don't leave me, I'm so scared...there are all weird things here..."

When Lin Ke saw that she was about to cry, he immediately softened his heart and put his arm around her shoulders to comfort her:

"Don't worry, we will definitely not abandon you!"
